summary: Joseph Heitzler of the Wehrlehof, Oberried-Vörlinsbach; round-2 candidate C — ruled out.
bio: Son of Andreas Haitzler (b. 1731 Wehrlehof) and Magdalena Maier of Falkensteig; grandparents Andreas Haitzler (b. c.1710) and Ottilia Maier. Married Maria Rombach (1781–1854); six daughters 1812–1822, four recorded (1812, 1813 Rosina, 1818, 1822). The family had 'grown poor' and lived in the Wehrlehof's Stöckle (retirement cottage). The Wehrlehof was the farm of Mathias Haizler & Ottilia Schirk (1723–24).
